Touch

left thumb — move · push far — sprint
tap — strike · keep tapping — the combo
tap at full sprint — running thrust (sword)
hold still, release — the charged attack chosen above
flick any way — roll that way · tap in the roll — rolling cut
blade-mark over a stunned foe: tap — the finishing cut
behind an unwary foe: tap — the backstab (small and medium horrors)
the katana — cuts a horror below half its life clean in two where it lands
hold & drag — turn the camera · walk into a mote — take it
time a swing into theirs — clash: sparks, and they reel
first person — the 3RD / 1ST switch by the pause button (or the view above): guns for blades · a trigger under each thumb, and the right one drags to turn while you fire · aim · reload · dodge · tap the bar to swap · the rail takes iron sights, a red dot or an acog (the attachment row above)

Keyboard

W A S D — move · R (hold) — sprint
J or Space — strike · repeat — the combo
L (hold, release) — the charged attack
K or Shift — roll · J in the roll — rolling cut
E — claim the altar · Z / C — turn the camera
Esc — pause
first person — click to take the mouse · LMB / J fire · RMB / L aim · R reload · Q, 1–3 swap · F zoom · Shift sprint · Space dodge

Controller

left stick — move · push far — sprint · right stick — look
R1 — strike / fire · R2 (hold, release) — the charged attack / fire
○ — roll · ✕ — claim the altar · △ — swap · □ — reload
L2 — aim (first person) · L1 — the auto-lock · create — 1st / 3rd · options — pause
